recipe.visualDefinition: A high-energy Y2K-era graphic featuring a central 3D extruded title over a techno-organic background of glowing concentric rings and metallic circular indentations. The style is defined by heavy use of cyan, lime green, and deep blue gradients with a grainy, digital texture.
coreVisualRelationships: Central 3D title dominates the mid-ground against a circular background
Secondary text frames the top and bottom in a wide, technical sans-serif
Gradients transition from lime yellow to cyan to create a 'glowing' effect
Deep blue shadows provide depth to the extruded letterforms
coreInvariants: Heavy 3D extrusion on the main title

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The main title is centered and scaled to occupy 60% of the frame width, staggered vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large 3D '2000' numerals at the bottom-center of the main title block.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down reading order, starting with the header, dropping to the large central title, and ending on the artist list at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the background is filled with textures and glowing rings to maintain high energy.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy and cyan for the background and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Lime green and bright yellow for the letter faces and highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Electric blue for the 3D extrusion depths.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation with extreme value shifts from dark shadows to bright, glowing highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to cool-toned metallics and neon greens

letterConstructionRules: Main title uses lowercase, slanted, thick-weight glyphs with rounded corners
Secondary text is all-caps, ultra-extended, and square-shaped
3D extrusion depth is approximately 20% of the letter height
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'a' and 'd' in the main title feature a continuous loop-like structure
The 'y' has a long, straight descender following the slant angle
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between organic, slanted display type and rigid, horizontal technical type.

candidateDirections.reason: Perfect match for the technical, wide secondary text.
Good base for the rounded, heavy lowercase display title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a Y2K techno background with concentric glowing cyan rings, metallic circular indentations, and a deep blue-to-green radial gradient with digital grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, slanted 3D extruded title in the center using a lime-green gradient face and blue depth. Place ultra-wide, all-caps technical sans-serif text at the top and bottom margins.

verificationChecks: Is the main title 3D and slanted?
Does the background feature glowing concentric circles?
Is the color palette strictly cyan, lime, and navy?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the 3D extrusion direction is consistent across all letters.
Check that the ultra-wide text is perfectly horizontal.
Verify the grain texture doesn't obscure the text legibility.
Confirm the lime-green and cyan contrast is vibrant.
recipe.reuseFormula: Techno-Futurism = (3D Extruded Rounded Type + Ultra-Wide Technical Sans) * (Concentric Glowing Rings + Metallic Gradients)
